{{Quote|You have fought well, old one, but I ''feel'' your exhaustion!|An Anzati assassin compliments Oppo Rancisis' skill with his lightsaber|<ref name="Rep75" />}}
[[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]]'s '''lightsaber''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] created by the [[Thisspiasian/Legends|Thisspiasian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].<ref name="PotJ" /> It had a single [[Color/Legends|green]] blade and a cylindrical, straight, gray-colored [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] with a rectangular, jutting guard on its [[Blade emitter/Legends|blade emitter]].<ref name="Rep75" />

Oppo Rancisis wielded the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] during his tenure on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], using it in ceremonial recognition of his fellow Jedi [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle's]] ascension to the rank of Jedi Master,<ref name="Yaddle's Tale">{{Tales|5|Yaddle's Tale: The One Below}}</ref> and, later, in [[Raid on the Jedi Temple (Yinchorri Uprising)|defense]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] against the [[Yinchorri Uprising]]<ref name="JC2">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 2|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 2]]</ref> of [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> During the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]], a battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Rancisis, now acting as a Republic strategist, used the saber in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|battle]] against [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] dispatched by Confederate [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him.<ref name="Rep75" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oppo Rancisis' lightsaber first appeared in the [[Jedi Council: Acts of War 2|second issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'']] series, written by [[Randy Stradley]], illustrated by [[Davidé Fabbri]],<ref name="JC2" /> and published on [[July 19]]th, [[2000]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54291/star_wars_jedi_council_-_acts_of_war_2000_2|text=Star Wars: Jedi Council - Acts of War (2000) #2}}</ref> It was first identified by name in a [[StarWars.com]] liveblog of a [[Celebration Anaheim (2015)|Star Wars Celebration]] panel discussing the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated series, written by the StarWars.com team and published on [[April 16]], [[2015]].<ref name="TCW">{{SW|url=news/swca-the-untold-clone-wars-panel-liveblog|text=SWCA: The Untold ''Clone Wars'' Panel Liveblog}}</ref>

While the cover of the [[Republic 75|75th issue]] of Dark Horse's ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' series depicts a duel between Rancisis, wielding this lightsaber, and Sora Bulq, Bulq kills Rancisis without combat in the issue itself.<ref name="Rep75" />

Although Rancisis' lightsaber did not appear in ''The Clone Wars'', it was pictured in concept art created on [[April 14]]th of [[2012]] by [[Pat Presley]], which depicted it with a finger guard and a curved hilt modeled on [[Dooku's lightsaber/Legends|Dooku's lightsaber]],<ref name="TCW" /> rather than the simple cylinder of its published appearances.<ref name="Rep75" />
